description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Xezat], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Earth abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [ATB_10%] after using Earth abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Earth 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Deprotect 20% (15s)] to all enemies if at least one target has at least 40% earth imperil, grants [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)] to all enemies if not.

description.name: Earth Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Earth attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Earth 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Earth ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Deprotect 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases physical damage taken by 20%, cumulable
